query: Give me a digest of all my unread emails, grouped by sender, with one line per email.
answer:
**16 unread emails**, grouped by sender. Times are UTC.

**EnronOnline System**
- **Oct 15, 06:00 — Trade confirmation #EOL-88213:** Confirms 10,000 MMBtu of Henry Hub gas for November delivery at $2.41, counterparty Reliant Energy.

**GasBank Platform**
- **Oct 14, 14:00 — GasBank daily position alert:** Net long 4.2 Bcf across storage contracts; no limit breaches.
- **Oct 12, 06:00 — GasBank: margin call warning:** NYMEX collateral requirement increased by $18 million; Treasury notified.

**Jeff Skilling**
- **Oct 14, 08:00 — Raptor hedge valuation:** Requests an independent estimate of the Raptor hedges’ credit-capacity shortfall; mentions figures around $500 million.

**John Lavorato**
- **Oct 13, 10:00 — Gas volatility spike - need model run:** Requests a storage valuation rerun using the new 85% implied-volatility surface and results today. **Flagged; high importance.**

**Kenneth Lay**
- **Oct 15, 01:00 — All-employee meeting follow-up:** Requests a short note on how Research supports the trading businesses before Friday. **High importance.**
- **Oct 12, 12:00 — Board meeting prep:** Requests a non-technical, one-page summary of market risk exposures for the October board meeting. **High importance.**

**Legal Ticketing**
- **Oct 13, 14:00 — Ticket LT-4480: URGENT compliance hold:** Retention hold issued for the trading analytics group; do not delete research files. **High importance.**

**Louise Kitchen**
- **Oct 3, 10:00 — EnronOnline analytics proposal:** Proposes a real-time order-flow analytics dashboard; estimated budget is $400,000.

**Mark Taylor**
- **Sep 20, 10:00 — Contract template update:** Legal updated the ISDA schedule template; use it for research-supported deals.

**Rebecca Mark**
- **Oct 14, 02:00 — Dynegy joint venture term sheet:** Draft weather-risk-products JV term sheet attached; proposes a 60/40 split with Dynegy as majority partner.
- **Oct 13, 04:00 — Re: Dynegy joint venture term sheet:** Requests comments on the valuation appendix before Dynegy’s board meeting on Oct 24.

**Sally Beck**
- **Oct 14, 20:00 — Risk Committee materials:** VaR summary and updated risk limits attached for the meeting; attachments include `VaR_summary.pdf` and `risk_limits.xls`.
- **Oct 13, 20:00 — VaR model review schedule:** Internal audit proposes Oct 22–26 for the annual review; review calendar attached.
- **Sep 27, 10:00 — Audit request: model inventory:** Requests a complete inventory of production pricing models by the end of the month.

**Zimin Lu**
- **Oct 12, 22:00 — Spread option pricing question:** Asks whether to use the Margrabe formula or two-factor Monte Carlo for spark spread options; heat rate is 10,500 Btu/kWh.

query: Get me ready for the Project Raptor Deep Dive: who's attending, what's still open in my Raptor backlog, and what the latest Raptor emails say.
answer:
## Project Raptor Deep Dive

**Meeting:** Wednesday, October 17, 2001, **14:00–16:00 UTC**  
**Location:** EB 50M  
**Focus:** Raptor collar valuations for Arthur Andersen.

### Attendees and RSVP
- **Mark Taylor** — organizer
- **Jeff Skilling** — accepted
- **Stinson Gibner** — accepted
- **You (Vince Kaminski)** — RSVP not recorded

### Open items in Project Raptor Backlog
| Item | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|
| Raptor hedge MTM recalculation | In progress; high importance | October 16, 17:00 UTC |
| Collect Andersen questions | Not started | October 18, 17:00 UTC |
| Draft Raptor disclosure notes | Not started | October 22, 17:00 UTC |

### Latest Raptor emails in your Inbox
- **Oct 14, 18:00 UTC — Mark Taylor, “Raptor SPE structure - legal review”**: Legal wants your view on whether the hedge valuations are supportable. Includes `raptor_structure.pdf`.
- **Oct 14, 08:00 UTC — Jeff Skilling, “Raptor hedge valuation”**: Requests your independent estimate of the credit-capacity shortfall; he has heard figures around **$500 million**. This email is unread.
- **Oct 13, 18:00 UTC — Mark Taylor, “Re: Raptor SPE structure - legal review”**: Arthur Andersen requested the valuation memo by **October 18** and asks whether your team can draft it.
- **Oct 12, 18:00 UTC — Mark Taylor, “Raptor: Arthur Andersen questions”**: Andersen sent **12 questions** on the collars; answers are needed by **October 18**.

**Preparation priorities:** finish the MTM recalculation, develop an independent shortfall estimate, assess whether the valuations are supportable, and align the memo and Andersen-question responses to the October 18 deadline.

## Louise Kitchen: email briefing

Louise’s emails in your Inbox:

- **Oct 15 — “EnronOnline volumes - weekly summary”**: EnronOnline recorded **6,112 trades** and **$3.2 billion** in notional value last week; gas products were **58% of volume**.

- **Oct 13 — “EnronOnline new product launch”**: Said bandwidth trading was planned for next month and asked Research for a pricing methodology for bandwidth swaps.
- **Oct 3 — “EnronOnline analytics proposal”**: Proposed a real-time dashboard for EnronOnline order flow, with a **$400,000** budget estimate.

## Your commitment to her

- In your **Oct 14** reply, you said your team **would refresh the gas curves by Wednesday morning (Oct 17, UTC)**.

I found no sent reply to her about the bandwidth pricing methodology or analytics proposal in your Sent Items.

query: Prep me for the FERC Compliance Review: who will be there and what deadlines matter?
answer:
## FERC Compliance Review

**When:** Tuesday, October 16, 2001, **11:00–12:00 UTC**  
**Where:** EB 47C1  
**Purpose:** Review the draft FERC market-behavior filing.

**Who’s expected:**
- **Steven Kean** — organizer
- **Richard Shapiro** — accepted
- **You** — marked accepted

**Deadlines to keep in view:**
- **October 17:** Your group’s price-formation analysis is due to Steven so Legal can review it. Your calendar has focus time for FERC price-formation analysis that morning, **09:00–12:00 UTC**.
- **October 19:** The quarterly FERC market-behavior filing is due.
- The filing may include an appendix on model methodology; **keep it under 10 pages**. No specific submission times were given for either deadline.

**Scheduling conflict:** The FERC review overlaps with the **Dynegy Partnership Review**, also scheduled October 16, **11:00–12:00 UTC**. You have not responded to that invitation.
